technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
The materials of the solar panels are: solar cells, ribbons, glass, encapsulant, junction box, silicone and frame (only some models, see below).
The modules by Solitek have an efficiency of around 22.27%. The wafer thickness is 130 um.
All the photovoltaic panels covered in the EPD have an aluminium frame, except for: SOLID Bifacial B108 435W, SOLID Bifacial full black B108 435W, and SOLID AGRO B.72 Increased Transparency 290W.
technology.technologicalApplicability: Depending on the model, the solar panels are designed for roof installation or for agricultural applications. Please, see the information about the individual models on the EPD to see the optimal application.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.useAdviceForDataSet: The end-of-life scenarios are modelled according to solar panel waste treatment in Sweden.
